channel.title: CWI Lab: Signal Sessions
channel.description: CWI Lab: Signal Sessions (working title) — the weekly show from Cumulative Web Inc where hosts Marcus and Nia spin a track in full and run it through the CWI tool bench live on the air: the Trust Verdict Checker, an audio quality report, and a lyric sheet generator. Five acts: cold open, the spin, the lab, the verdict, the call to action. New episode every Friday, tied to the 8 PM Eastern Listening Room session. Artists: submit your track at https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-listening-sessions/submit.html
